name: tendercells
description: Ask about your Tender Cells farm, explore missions and Builder projects, and get a read-only learning card.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to your Tender Cells hub on your own network. Read coop conditions, animal-health flags, alerts and yard events; explore six learning missions and three Builder projects one step at a time with safety gates, checkpoints and source references. Concept books are clearly marked and never treated as verified wiring instructions. E-STOP remains available locally. Hardware actions (door, feed, relay) are off unless you turn them on, and each one needs your explicit yes with a single-use code. No hub yet? Turn on Demo farm to try it with simulated devices.

tools.name: get_farm_overview
tools.description: Every device with readings, animal-health flags, yard flags and alerts; shows the farm card.

tools.name: get_farm_home
tools.description: Concise farm status, devices and attention items.

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: List accessible devices with online, state and health status.

tools.name: get_mission
tools.description: Read one mission step with learner depth and checkpoints.

tools.name: list_builder_projects
tools.description: List existing Builder projects and concept books.

tools.name: get_builder_project
tools.description: Read project metadata, parts, stages and source references.

tools.name: get_builder_step
tools.description: Read one existing project step with safety gates and source references.

tools.name: get_device
tools.description: One device's telemetry, state and presence.

tools.name: get_yard_events
tools.description: Eggs ready, weeds, headcount and other yard flags.

tools.name: emergency_stop
tools.description: Stop every actuator on a device. Always available.

tools.name: request_action

tools.name: confirm_action

prompts.name: farm_check

prompts.name: evening_lockup

hub_url.title: Hub URL
hub_url.description: Your Tender Cells hub on your network, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:4000

hub_token.title: Hub sign-in token
hub_token.description: Only if your hub requires accounts: a Firebase ID token (expires after an hour).

demo.title: Demo farm
demo.description: Use a simulated farm instead of a hub - try it with no hardware.

allow_actions.title: Allow hardware actions
allow_actions.description: Let Claude prepare door / feed / relay actions. Each still needs your yes and a single-use code. Off by default. On the demo farm they only move simulated devices.
